items.name: theme
items.title: Theme tokens
items.description: Surface, accent and status tokens shared by every component.

items.name: motion-tokens
items.title: Motion tokens
items.description: Shared easing curves, springs and enter/exit transitions.

items.name: use-mock-run
items.title: useMockRun
items.description: Plays scripted agent runs for demos and tests.

items.name: surface
items.title: Surface
items.description: Shell, Panel, Inset, IconTile and ShellHeader — the borderless layers every component is framed with.

items.name: action-button
items.title: Action Button
items.description: Silver primary, secondary, quiet and danger buttons in two sizes, with icons, loading and icon-only buttons.

items.name: choice-controls
items.title: Choice Controls
items.description: Switch, borderless Checkbox with a mixed state, and a RadioGroup with arrow-key navigation.

items.name: status-pill
items.title: Status Pill
items.description: Tinted status pills in five tones with icon or dot, plus a mono Tag for models, branches and transports.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Radio-style segmented switch with a sliding active pill that jumps instantly from the keyboard.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: Progress and meter bars in five tones with optional stripes, plus a stacked SegmentedBar.

items.name: rolling-number
items.title: Rolling Number
items.description: Odometer-style number: each digit rolls to its new value, units and separators stay put.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text Field
items.description: Borderless TextField, SearchField with clear and TextArea, with label, description and error wiring.

items.name: tooltip-hint
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Hint anchored to its trigger: scales in from the trigger side, opens instantly once one is warm.

items.name: action-menu
items.title: Action Menu
items.description: Dropdown and right-click menus — items with icons and shortcuts, submenus, checkable items and a destructive group.

items.name: popover-panel
items.title: Popover Panel
items.description: A panel anchored to its trigger — grows from it, closes on outside click or Esc, keeps focus inside.

items.name: modal-sheet
items.title: Modal Sheet
items.description: Centered dialog and edge sheet (drawer) — focus trap, scroll lock, Esc and backdrop to close.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast Stack
items.description: Notifications that stack, expand on hover, pause while hovered, swipe or click to dismiss, with actions.

items.name: select-field
items.title: Select Field
items.description: Select and searchable combobox — options with icons and hints, groups, keyboard typeahead.

items.name: tab-panels
items.title: Tab Panels
items.description: Tabs with panels — sliding indicator, keyboard navigation, lazy panels and counts.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: Accordion and single collapsible sections with smooth height animation.

items.name: agent-avatar
items.title: Agent Avatar
items.description: Avatars for agents and people — initials or image, presence and activity state, stacked groups.

items.name: loading-skeleton
items.title: Loading Skeleton
items.description: Placeholders for answers, lists and cards while they load.

items.name: range-slider
items.title: Range Slider
items.description: Single and range sliders with steps, marks and value labels — for temperature, length, budgets.

items.name: key-hint
items.title: Key Hint
items.description: Keyboard shortcut hints that adapt to the platform — Cmd on Mac, Ctrl elsewhere.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Spinner and thinking indicators in a few sizes, with an accessible label.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Empty, no-results and error states with an icon, message and actions.

items.name: date-field
items.title: Date Field
items.description: Calendar and date picker — month grid, ranges, keyboard navigation and min / max.

items.name: drop-zone
items.title: Drop Zone
items.description: Drag-and-drop file target for a chat — accepts types and size limits, shows why a file was rejected.

items.name: ai-chat
items.title: AI Chat
items.description: A complete chat app screen — history sidebar, a thread with tool calls, cited answers and feedback, follow-up chips and a composer with a context meter.

items.name: coding-agent
items.title: Coding Agent
items.description: An agent working in a repo — chat with plan and permission requests on one side, file changes, terminal and a live preview on the other.

items.name: data-answer
items.title: Data Answer
items.description: An analytics question answered with KPI cards, a chart and a table, plus follow-up questions to dig further.

items.name: booking-assistant
items.title: Booking Assistant
items.description: An assistant that acts — compares options, picks a time, fills a form and confirms before it books.

items.name: agent-console
items.title: Agent Console
items.description: A team view of agents in production — background runs, a trace, eval results, usage and rate limits.

items.name: support-widget
items.title: Support Widget
items.description: A support bot embedded on a website — launcher bubble, quick replies, order lookup, handoff to a human and a rating at the end.

items.name: handoff-inbox
items.title: Handoff Inbox
items.description: Where people take over from the bot — escalated conversations by urgency, what the bot already did, reply and hand back.

items.name: streaming-message
items.title: Streaming Message
items.description: Assistant message with token streaming, collapsible reasoning, citation chips and copy / retry actions.

items.name: agent-status
items.title: Agent Status
items.description: Live activity line for a working agent — current step, rotating detail, elapsed time and a stop action.

items.name: message-branches
items.title: Message Branches
items.description: Switch between regenerated answers and edited prompts — arrows, a mini branch map, and direction-aware swaps.

items.name: response-feedback
items.title: Response Feedback
items.description: Thumbs up or down under an answer; a down vote opens reason chips and a note, then settles into a thank-you.

items.name: agent-composer
items.title: Agent Composer
items.description: Prompt input with Ask / Plan / Act modes, a context tray with token counts and messages that queue while the agent works.

items.name: agent-question
items.title: Agent Question
items.description: Agent asks with choice cards, marks its own suggestion and reason, and accepts a pick, several picks or free text.

items.name: tool-approval-queue
items.title: Tool Approval Queue
items.description: Triage pending tool calls by risk: select several, grant once, for the session or always, and undo from the resolved log.

items.name: tool-call-block
items.title: Tool Call Block
items.description: Inline chat card for a tool call: name, collapsible JSON args, status, duration and a result preview.

items.name: file-changes
items.title: File Changes
items.description: Split review: a file tree on one side, hunks on the other — keep or revert each hunk, then apply the result.

items.name: terminal-output
items.title: Terminal Output
items.description: Streaming command output with stdout / stderr lines, exit status, duration, copy and stop.

items.name: mcp-servers
items.title: MCP Servers
items.description: Connected MCP servers with status, auth prompts and reconnect — expand one to switch individual tools on or off.

items.name: background-agents
items.title: Background Agents Panel
items.description: Agents working in the background as a grid of live tiles or a compact dock that expands into the selected agent.

items.name: checkpoint-timeline
items.title: Checkpoint Timeline
items.description: Checkpoints the agent made along the way — scrub through turns, see what changed, restore to any point.

items.name: run-trace
items.title: Run Trace
items.description: Flame graph of an agent run with click-to-zoom spans, plus a breakdown of where time, tokens and cost went.

items.name: eval-results
items.title: Eval Results
items.description: An eval run as a grid of cases — pass, fail or regressed vs the baseline — with per-case input, expected and actual.

items.name: lap-timer
items.title: Lap Timer
items.description: A pipeline run as a stopwatch — the hand sweeps through each stage's sector, with splits and the delta against the best lap.

items.name: eval-race
items.title: Eval Race
items.description: Models racing through an eval set on an oval track — one lap per batch of cases, with standings, gaps and the fastest lap.

items.name: context-window-meter
items.title: Context Window Meter
items.description: Token usage by segment — system, history, files, tools — with a near-limit warning and a compact action.

items.name: memory-panel
items.title: Memory Panel
items.description: What the agent remembers about the user and project — search, scopes, inline edit and forget.

items.name: usage-summary
items.title: Usage Summary
items.description: Tokens and cost over time, split by model, against a monthly budget.

items.name: rate-limits
items.title: Rate Limits
items.description: Requests and tokens per minute as refilling buckets, with a retry-after countdown and queued calls when throttled.

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat Thread
items.description: The conversation itself — user and assistant turns, grouping, date dividers, unread marker and a jump-to-latest pill.

items.name: user-message
items.title: User Message
items.description: A sent prompt with attachments, edit-in-place and resend, copy, and a delivery state.

items.name: conversation-list
items.title: Conversation List
items.description: Chat history for a sidebar — search, pinned and dated groups, rename inline, archive and delete with undo.

items.name: prompt-suggestions
items.title: Prompt Suggestions
items.description: Starter prompts for an empty chat and follow-up chips under an answer.

items.name: attachment-preview
items.title: Attachment Preview
items.description: Images and files attached to a prompt — thumbnails, type and size, upload progress, retry and remove.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code in an answer — filename, language, line numbers, wrap toggle, copy and collapse for long snippets.

items.name: source-list
items.title: Source List
items.description: Citations behind an answer — numbered footnotes with hover previews and a panel of every source used.

items.name: chart-card
items.title: Chart Card
items.description: A chart the agent answers with — bar, line, area or donut, with tooltips, legend toggles and animated data.

items.name: dot-histogram
items.title: Dot Histogram
items.description: A distribution as stacked dots — every sample visible, median and p95 marked, samples past a limit such as a timeout flagged.

items.name: tick-gauge
items.title: Tick Gauge
items.description: A meter drawn as ticks around an arc, with a target marker and the shortfall to it in red — success rates, SLOs, budgets.

items.name: mirror-strips
items.title: Mirror Strips
items.description: Rows of dot strips with two series mirrored around a line — compare rounds or weeks on one axis, with pinned columns and notes.

items.name: radial-dots
items.title: Radial Dots
items.description: A cycle as rings of dots — hours of the day or days of the week, stacked by series, with the headline in the middle.

items.name: match-field
items.title: Match Field
items.description: A fit field — candidates, bots or options placed by score around a centre, grouped into sectors, with threshold rings.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: Scores across several axes as a polygon, with a dashed bar to meet and each member's values as dots on the spokes.

items.name: diverging-bars
items.title: Diverging Bars
items.description: Stacked daily columns with one series hanging below zero on its own scale — triaged vs escalated, solved vs handed off.

items.name: blast-radius
items.title: Blast Radius
items.description: What a key, agent or tool can reach, hop by hop around a centre, with the affected paths in red.

items.name: iso-bars
items.title: Iso Bars
items.description: Isometric stacked bars in two rows — the main volume behind, rework or failures in front.

items.name: hex-density
items.title: Hex Density
items.description: A density map of two measures in hexagons, split by a threshold line — retrieved vs dropped, fast vs slow.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Tabular results — sortable columns, filter, pagination, row selection and copy as CSV.

items.name: stat-grid
items.title: Stat Grid
items.description: KPI cards with rolling numbers, deltas and sparklines for a quick summary answer.

items.name: form-card
items.title: Form Card
items.description: A form the agent asks the user to fill — fields, selects, validation and a submitted state.

items.name: result-carousel
items.title: Result Carousel
items.description: A row of result cards — image, title, meta and an action — with snap scrolling and arrows.

items.name: slot-picker
items.title: Slot Picker
items.description: Pick a time the agent proposed — days, free slots, time zone and a confirm step.

items.name: confirmation-card
items.title: Confirmation Card
items.description: A summary of what the agent is about to do — line items, totals and confirm or edit before it acts.

items.name: json-viewer
items.title: JSON Viewer
items.description: Structured output as a collapsible tree — types, counts, search, copy path and copy value.

items.name: artifact-panel
items.title: Artifact Panel
items.description: A side canvas for what the agent made — live preview and source tabs, version history and download.
